name: green-level-tracked-closed
note: G-LIVE §2.1. A CLOSED tracked level freezes at its RIGHT-EDGE bar. extend.bars with bars=2 spawns at 1 and ends at 3, so the price is high[3]=19 — neither the spawn value (13) nor the last bar's (17). Three distinct values kill both wrong-bar mutants with one fixture.
